bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 54,000 views this week. One small circle.
beats.text: Your “Comment RETIRE” Reel passed 54,000 views and 496 comments this week, and you have 27,200 followers. Your top offer is a 12-month mastermind for a capped group of women.

beats.title: They're asking you about their own retirement.
beats.text: Rule of 55, “how long $1 million lasts”, “zero saved at 50”: hundreds of women comment for your guides every week. The ones close to retiring are exactly who the mastermind is for.

beats.title: “I'm ready now”, then two business days of waiting.
beats.text: Your mastermind application ends with “my team will reply personally within 2 business days”. The woman who just said she's ready has nothing to book and nothing to prepare with while she waits.

beats.title: “My team replies to everyone.” They still can.
beats.text: A calendar on the thank-you page doesn't replace the personal touch, it times it. Your team talks to women who already picked a slot and watched what to expect, instead of chasing replies.
beats.quote: “Your retirement date is a math problem. Let's solve it.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough list of your accounts ready: 401(k), IRA, brokerage and savings.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Lisa

preCallEmails.subject: A math problem, not a mystery
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most women I work with have done more right than they think. What's missing is someone looking at their numbers and turning them into a date.

That's what we do in the Mastermind.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Lisa

preCallEmails.subject: "I've already got the Blueprint"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Great, then you know how I teach.

The Blueprint gives you the method. The Mastermind is where we apply it to your accounts, live, for twelve months.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Lisa

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Lisa

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Lisa's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Lisa

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Lisa
